text: World War II ended in 1945. The war in Europe concluded on May 8, 1945 (V-E Day, Victory in Europe), when Nazi Germany surrendered to Allied forces. The war in the Pacific ended on September 2, 1945 (V-J Day, Victory over Japan), when Japan formally signed the instrument of surrender aboard the USS Missouri in Tokyo Bay, following the atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki in August 1945.
